Description: Dataset-level inventory of stimulus images stored in the stimuli directory.

image_id.Description: Unique identifier assigned to each stimulus image within the NVD dataset.

coco_id.Description: Identifier of the corresponding source image in the COCO image dataset.

stimulus_set.Description: Indicates whether the image belongs to the Shared or Unique stimulus set

viewed_by.LongName: Participants who viewed the stimulus image
viewed_by.Description: Indicates whether the image was viewed by all participants or only by a single participant. The value all denotes images presented to all participants; values of the form sub-<label> denote images presented only to the corresponding participant.

Levels.all: The image was presented to all participants.

task_id.Description: Identifier of the experimental task or session-specific stimulus list in which the image was used.

hard_subset.Description: Boolean indicator of whether the image belongs to the Hard Subset selected from semantically dense CLIP embedding clusters.

Levels.true: The image belongs to the Hard Subset.
Levels.false: The image does not belong to the Hard Subset.

hard_subset_cluster_id.Description: Cluster identifier for images belonging to the Hard Subset. The value n/a indicates that the image is not a Hard Subset image and therefore has no Hard Subset cluster assignment.
